Gamakamañjarī
saṅgīta. by Bhāva Bhaṭṭa. Bikaner 3402.
--C. by a. himself. Bikaner 3403.

Gamana
name of C. on Yantrarāja. jy.

Gamanikāsūtravṛtti
on Jain religion. by Tilakācārya. Lahore 22 (with text).

Gamaśāsana
authority ref. by Abhinavagupta in Tantrāloka, Vol. X. Āh. 16, (Kas. Texts 52) p. 117.

Gamaśāstra
authority ref. by Abhinavagupta in Tantrāloka, Vol. IX. Āh. 15 (Kas. Texts 49), p.. 138, 213, 267.

Gambhīrarāya(rāja)bhāratī
17th Cent. A. D.; son of Yamājī an. Candramā; was a. officer in Bijapur court under the Muslims; father of Bhāskararāya (well-known Tāntric writer, a. of Varivasyārahasya, C. on Lalitāsahasranāma etc.) an. Sakhārāma Dīkṣita (a. of C. on [Page311-b] Chandaḥsūtra, Adyar D.

); learned Āgamas from his maternal uncle Nārāyaṇa; lived in his old age a. Kasi. See K. C. Pandey, Abhinavagupta, p. 585.
--(Chando) Vārttikarāja. BISM. v.. 54/7. ref. to by Sakhārāma a. one of the sources of his work (Adyar D.

).
--C. Padyaprasūnāñjali (metrical) on Viṣṇusahasranāmastotra. BORI. D. XIII. iii. 950. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 12.

Gambhīravajra
Bud.
--Guhyārthaprakāśa Mahādbhutanāma. Cordier II. p. 72.

Gambhīravijayagāṇi
disciple of Vṛddhivijaya.
--C. Śabdabhāvokti on Adhyātmasāra of Yaśovijaya.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 153a.
Pt.. Jaina Dharma Prasāraka Sabhā, Bhavnagar: Bombay, 1909.
--C. Vivaraṇa on Jñānasāra of Yaśovijaya.
Pt.. 2nd edn. Ahmedabad, 1906.
--C. Śaṁkarīṭīkā on Nayakarṇikā of Vinayavijaya. BORI. D. XVIII. i. 7.
Pt.. Jainastotrasaṅgraha Pt. I. p.. 36-44. Jaina Yaśovij.

, Benares, 1906.
--C. on Śāntasudhārasa of Vinayavijaya.
Pt.. Jaina Dharma Prasāraka Sabhā, Bhavnagar: Bombay, 1913.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 35. 840. 1188. 1756. 1132 an. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 302. 1247. 1292.

Gambhīrastava
Jain. (Beg. atha gambhIranirghoSaH) Pattan I. p.. 65 (40 verses in Skt.). 70 (a. appears to be Vimala).

Gambhīrānanda
disciple of Pūrṇānanda.
--Ambāstava. in Āryā verses. (Beg. zrIpUrNAnandaguroH karuNApAGgaprasAdalezena | gambhIrAnando'haM racayAmyambAstavaM ruciram ||) Mad. Uni. R. K.

Gambhīrārthaviśodhana
Pāli. gr. in 319 verses. by Kyī Pwei of Pagan.
Pt.. with Burmese transl. Rangoon, 1922. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 533.
